object: Sol Cloud 19 BLAKE3-r2 archive and finite-result audit
question: Is the Sol Cloud 19 result archive internally authentic, and what of its reusable-E3 claims is independently reproduced without overclaiming solver timeouts?
number: Clean extraction verifies all 52 SHA256.json manifest entries exactly (0 missing, 0 mismatched); the separate reproduction reruns exact_checks, pin_analysis, and blake3_model. The archive establishes only bounded isolated-fibre and neutral-mask facts. The legal 55/63-byte seed is not a collision because 9bc61055 != ROR8(0680389c)=9c068038. Full-width lifts remain UNKNOWN at timeout; no reusable family, 2^-48 probability, or score <=48 is certified.
source: our workflow: clean extraction and manifest audit of SOLCLOUD_19_RESULTS.zip plus separate local reruns of archived finite-check scripts
held_fixed: Clean archive copy is untouched; local reproduction uses a separate copied tree. Solver UNKNOWNs and archived Boolector result are not treated as impossibility or local executable proof.
notes: Read-only audit only. No package/stage/filing/submission change. pyboolector is unavailable locally, so the archived Boolector UNSAT is reported but not rerun.
reopen_if: A legal upstream generator with a proved family size/density and accepted per-member charge, or a reproducible full-width E1/E3 collision family, becomes available
